description: This PHP source file defines the EmployeeGender class in the OrangeHRM project, specifically within the Reporting DisplayField DTOs. It models an employee's gender as a stringable object that returns gender labels based on internal integer codes.

classes.name: EmployeeGender
classes.description: Represents an employee's gender as a string, based on internal integer codes, and implements Stringable to provide string representation.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes EmployeeGender with an optional integer gender value.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string label ('Male', 'Female', 'Other') corresponding to the gender code, or null if unspecified.
